name: Wispr Flow
tagline: Dictation that types into any app
description: Wispr Flow is a dictation app that turns speech into written text in any app, and it also offers a Notetaker for meetings.
features: Dictation on Mac, Windows, iOS and Android
Notetaker for meetings (Mac and Windows; mobile on the roadmap)
audience: Students (50% off Pro with an education email)
strengths: Free plan with no credit card
limitations: Free plan is limited to 2,000 words per week on desktop
The Growth plan's prices were ambiguous on the page

plans.name: Growth
plans.note: The page shows $18 per user per month with SSO, HIPAA/BAA and unlimited Notetaker access; the billing period behind it is unconfirmed.

free.details: 2,000 words per week on desktop, limited weekly use on mobile and a weekly Notetaker meeting limit (amount not stated). No credit card needed.

pricing.regional: Currency shown as '$' without a code. Non-profits get a discounted rate (amount not stated).

verification.notes: Product active. The page has a Monthly / Annual (20% discount) toggle and shows Free $0 (2,000 words a week on desktop), Pro $12 per user/month, Growth $18 per user/month, Enterprise custom. The toggle could not be switched, so it is not confirmed that these are annual-billing figures; the stored monthly figure for Pro ($15) is from an earlier check.
verification.method: Opened in the Claude desktop built-in browser; page text read

profile.headline: Voice dictation that types polished text into any app, plus meeting notes

capabilities.title: Speak instead of typing
capabilities.text: Flow turns speech into clear, polished writing in any app where you can type.

capabilities.title: Clean up as you speak
capabilities.text: It removes filler words, adds punctuation, formats lists and emails, and applies corrections you make mid-sentence.

capabilities.title: Dictate in 100+ languages
capabilities.text: Selecting the language you speak gives the best accuracy.

capabilities.title: Record meetings
capabilities.text: Notetaker produces a transcript with speakers named, a topic-based summary and next steps.

featureCards.name: Works in every app
featureCards.text: No plugins; it types wherever your cursor is.

featureCards.name: Personal vocabulary
featureCards.text: Learns names, acronyms and jargon, and you can add words yourself.

featureCards.name: Snippets
featureCards.text: Speak a shortcut and it expands into saved text.

featureCards.name: Style settings
featureCards.text: A different tone for messages, work chats and emails.

featureCards.name: Privacy
featureCards.text: The site says data is never sold, and lists SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA and ISO 27001.

audienceDetail.text: Dictate into code editors, terminals and AI tools.
Both groups are listed among Wispr Flow users.

scenarios.title: Write a message without typing
scenarios.text: Dictate into Gmail, Slack or iMessage.

scenarios.title: Prompt an AI tool by voice
scenarios.text: Speak into ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor.

scenarios.title: Expand a shortcut
scenarios.text: Say a snippet name to insert an email or a link.

scenarios.title: Capture a meeting
scenarios.text: Record a Zoom, Meet, Teams or in-person meeting.

gettingStarted.text: For your device, using the free download.
And deselect the languages you do not speak.
The site advises against Bluetooth earbuds for dictation.
